content.title: Aehr Test Systems Lands Key Evaluation Order From Leading AI Chip Supplier
content.summary: Aehr Test Systems (NASDAQ:AEHR) said Tuesday it received an evaluation order from a leading artificial intelligence chip supplier to test its wafer-level burn-in technology. The program will be conducted at the company's Fremont, California, facility using its FOX-XP production system. Stock surged after the announcement. The initiative includes a custom WaferPak contactor designed for high-power devices. It will compare wafer-level burn-in results to the supplier's existing production process.
